name: Party Text Information 2
definition: Provides additional information regarding the party, for example, the contact unit or person responsible for the transaction identified in the message.

DeclarationDetails.name: Declaration Details
DeclarationDetails.definition: Provides declaration details narrative relative to the party.

PartyContactDetails.name: Party Contact Details
PartyContactDetails.definition: Provides additional information regarding the party, for example, the contact unit or person responsible for the transaction identified in the message.

AdditionalDetailsRule.definition: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if DeclarationlDetails and/or PartyContactDetails are present, then they must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.
